reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "SecretStore v1beta1 schema: 1 field now required: `spec.provider.fake.data[].value`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore objects (and, per the same rendered diff, ClusterSecretStore objects) whose spec.provider.fake.data[] entries omit value are rejected by the tightened CRD schema validation.
consequence.remediation: Add a value to every spec.provider.fake.data[] entry in external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore (and ClusterSecretStore) objects before applying them against the release carrying the tightened schema.

proposed.statement: Between external-secrets 0.15.0 and 0.16.0 the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items in the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore schema changed from [key] to [key,value] (the same diff shows the identical change for ClusterSecretStore), so objects that omit spec.provider.fake.data[].value are rejected.
